recommendation: Stable contact-aware MuJoCo demo: the FF Master rides a force-controlled vehicle down a tower while a measured-force roller paints the wall.

01_runnability.reason: Editable install, declared MuJoCo/video dependencies, viewer command, headless video command, and fast smoke test.

02_task_design.reason: Clear start and finish: standing robot begins at the top of the tower, paints during descent, reaches the bottom landing, and prints contact/coverage evidence.

03_control.reason: Vehicle descent, floating-base stabilization, joint posture, and roller placement are driven by generalized-force feedback controllers; paint is gated by measured MuJoCo contact force.

04_presentation.reason: Tower, rails, vehicle, paint bucket, hand-held roller, force-qualified paint swaths, and FF Master worker make the task easy to understand and verify.
